description: This file defines the CreateSnapshotAction type and associated methods for creating a snapshot in the Android Cuttlefish orchestration system. It manages snapshot creation by suspending, taking a snapshot, and resuming the device state, and interacts with external components via imported APIs and libraries.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotAction
classes.description: Represents an action to create a snapshot of an Android VM, encapsulating the snapshot process including suspension, snapshot, and resumption.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotActionOpts
classes.description: Options data structure for configuring a CreateSnapshotAction instance, including device selector, paths, operation manager, execution context, and user information.

methods.name: NewCreateSnapshotAction
methods.description: Constructor function that creates and initializes a new CreateSnapshotAction instance with provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the snapshot creation process asynchronously, returning the operation object.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Performs the actual snapshot creation by suspending the device, taking a snapshot, and resuming. Returns the snapshot response or an error.
